candidates.source_name: EBA EU-wide Transparency Exercise (bank-by-bank CSV database)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual, harmonised, bank-by-bank supervisory disclosure (capital, RWA, P&L, exposures, NPL, sovereign exposures) covering the Hungarian banks in the EU sample (historically OTP Bank Nyrt.; MBH/Erste HU appear via parent or national samples). Full CSV database plus data dictionary makes it the single best normalised, English-language, machine-readable cross-border mirror of Hungarian bank disclosures, and it survives independently of any bank's own IR site.
candidates.access_status: open, free, no registration
candidates.legal_status: public sector information, EBA reuse terms with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled annual download of the ZIP/CSV full database per exercise year (2016-2025 archived per-year landing pages); parse CSV with the published data dictionary; filter LEI/country code HU.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball into per-year archive pages
queries_used: EBA transparency exercise Hungary bank data download

candidates.source_name: EBA Credit Institutions Register
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level normalised list of authorised credit institutions including all Hungarian ones, with LEI, authorisation/withdrawal dates and national competent authority links. Authorisation-withdrawal records are the cleanest machine-readable evidence of Hungarian bank mergers (MKB/Budapest Bank/Takarek into MBH) that trigger IR-estate disappearance, so it anchors the entity timeline behind archived-site work.
candidates.access_status: open, full register downloadable
candidates.legal_status: public sector information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly download of the full register export; diff against prior snapshot to detect HU entity additions/withdrawals.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register PSD2 payment institutions register Hungary export

candidates.source_name: EBA Central Register of Payment and E-Money Institutions (PSD2)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates the MNB's national PSP register into an EU-wide, daily-updated, fully downloadable dataset covering Hungarian payment institutions, EMIs, account information/payment initiation service providers and their agents and passporting. This is the single most practical cross-border route to the Hungarian PSP population in English without reading Hungarian register pages.
candidates.access_status: open, free, whole-register download offered
candidates.legal_status: public sector information; mirrors national registers
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly full-register download filtered on home member state HU; track status changes and new authorisations as event signals.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register PSD2 payment institutions register Hungary export

candidates.source_name: MNB Kozzetetelek - officially appointed mechanism for regulated-market issuer disclosures
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory Hungarian OAM: every regulated (rendszeres) and extraordinary (rendkivuli) disclosure, annual and interim report of listed issuers - OTP Bank Nyrt., MBH-group issuers, bond issuers - is filed here and remains retrievable by document ID even after the issuer's own IR page is retired. Functionally the national mirror/archive that ESAP will federate from 2027.
candidates.access_status: open, free search; stable download endpoints observed (downloadkozzetetel?id=...)
candidates.legal_status: statutory public disclosure archive; reuse of filings subject to issuer copyright
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic search-form crawl by issuer name and date range; harvest PDF/ESEF attachments via the downloadkozzetetel endpoint; retain document IDs for stable re-fetch.
queries_used: MNB kozzetetelek.mnb.hu tokepiaci kozzeteteli rendszer kibocsatoi jelentesek

candidates.source_name: e-beszamolo - Electronic Financial Statements Portal (Ministry of Justice)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory national archive of filed statutory accounts (merleg, eredmenykimutatas, kiegeszito melleklet, konyvvizsgaloi jelentes) for every Hungarian legal entity including banks, PSPs and their subsidiaries, back to 1998 (XML/PDF since 2008). It is the surviving copy of accounts for entities whose corporate websites vanished in the MBH consolidation, and it is free where aggregators charge.
candidates.access_status: free public search and download; form-driven, no obvious API
candidates.legal_status: public statutory filings
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted per-entity retrieval by company registration number (cegjegyzekszam) or tax number, annually after the 31 May filing deadline; store XML where available for structured parsing.
queries_used: e-beszamolo portal ceginformacios szolgalat beszamolo kereso im.gov.hu

candidates.source_name: Ceginformacios portal / Ceginformacios Szolgalat (Ministry of Justice company register front-end)
candidates.why_relevant: Official company-register search giving registration numbers, legal successors and merger records for Hungarian banks and PSPs. Supplies the entity keys (cegjegyzekszam, tax number) that unlock e-beszamolo and the commercial aggregators, and evidences successor relationships after bank mergers.
candidates.access_status: free basic search; authenticated extracts are paid
candidates.legal_status: public register; paid certified documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume lookup to build and maintain the HU banking entity master list; do not bulk-crawl.
queries_used: e-beszamolo portal ceginformacios szolgalat beszamolo kereso im.gov.hu

candidates.source_name: OPTEN Cegtar / Merlegtar
candidates.why_relevant: Leading Hungarian commercial aggregator; Merlegtar normalises statutory filings from 1998 onward into Excel-ready balance sheet and P&L series, with company comparison and benchmarking reports. Free public company cards exist for the majors (OTP Bank Nyrt., MKB Bank Nyrt.), so it doubles as a low-cost lookup and as a persistent record for merged/dissolved entities.
candidates.access_status: freemium - free company cards, paid reports/subscription
candidates.legal_status: commercial licence required for systematic reuse; ToS likely forbids scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Licensed subscription with Excel/XML export for the HU bank and PSP entity list; manual free-card checks only for triage. Do not scrape.
queries_used: Opten ceginformacio merleg beszamolo bank

candidates.source_name: Dun & Bradstreet Hungary (formerly Bisnode D&B Magyarorszag) company database
candidates.why_relevant: Cross-border aggregator that normalises Hungarian court-register and filing data into the global D&B/DUNS structure, giving English-language, comparable records for Hungarian banks, PSPs and their group parents plus ownership trees and failure-risk scores. The legacy Bisnode free search remains a cheap lookup route.
candidates.access_status: freemium search; core data paid
candidates.legal_status: commercial licence; strict ToS on reuse and redistribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Commercial data feed / DUNS-keyed lookups for the HU banking and PSP universe; use free Bisnode search only for ad hoc identification.
queries_used: Dun & Bradstreet Hungary Bisnode ceginformacio magyar cegadatbazis

candidates.source_name: Ceginfo.hu
candidates.why_relevant: Hungarian company-data aggregator with per-entity profile pages that persist after corporate rebrands (e.g. it still carries the Bisnode D&B Magyarorszag identity for the renamed D&B Hungary entity). Useful as a redundancy layer and for legacy-name resolution when a Hungarian bank entity has been merged away.
candidates.access_status: freemium
candidates.legal_status: commercial ToS; derivative of public register data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-volume manual lookup for legacy-name resolution; not a bulk source.
queries_used: ceginfo.hu ceginformacio.hu cegadatbazis magyar bank penzintezet beszamolo letoltes

candidates.source_name: Ceginformacio.hu (bilingual HU/EN credit report and document download service)
candidates.why_relevant: Sells authenticated Hungarian company documents and multi-year balance sheet / P&L exports in Excel, with English-language report pages - one of the few routes that hands a non-Hungarian-speaking analyst a normalised English filing extract for a Hungarian bank or PSP subsidiary.
candidates.access_status: paid per document; free profile stubs
candidates.legal_status: commercial reseller of public register data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pay-per-report purchase for specific entities where English normalised financials are needed; not for bulk harvesting.
queries_used: ceginfo.hu ceginformacio.hu cegadatbazis magyar bank penzintezet beszamolo letoltes

candidates.source_name: Other Hungarian company-document resellers (onlineceginformacio.hu, cegjegyzek.hu, cegkivonat.com, cegtalalo.hu)
candidates.why_relevant: A cluster of resellers drawing on the same e-cegjegyzek / Ceginformacios Szolgalat backend, offering instant HU/EN/DE/FR certified extracts and multi-year Excel financials. Worth tracking as fallback access routes when the official portal is slow or a specific historical filing is hard to locate, and as a signal of what document types are commercially demanded.
candidates.access_status: paid
candidates.legal_status: commercial resellers of public register data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keep as a documented fallback list; purchase individual documents only when the official channels fail.

candidates.source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine (retired Hungarian bank IR estates)
candidates.why_relevant: Core of this cell's rationale: mkb.hu, budapestbank.hu and takarekbank.hu IR sections were folded into mbhbank.hu, so Wayback snapshots are frequently the only surviving access route to pre-merger annual reports, quarterly releases and IR press-release indexes. Wayback also carries the full-text .hu crawl since 1996 that the national library relies on.
candidates.access_status: open; rate limits and occasional 429/503 on heavy use
candidates.legal_status: archive of publicly published pages; underlying documents remain issuer copyright
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CDX API (web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx) per legacy host and path prefix to enumerate snapshots of IR/report directories, then fetch id_ raw captures of the PDFs; throttle requests.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cell rationale + confirmation that legacy IR estates were consolidated into mbhbank.hu

candidates.source_name: MNMKK OSZK Webarchivum (Hungarian national library web archive)
candidates.why_relevant: National-library archive with six-monthly snapshots of the Hungarian web space since 2017 plus thematic sub-collections - a second, jurisdictionally Hungarian archive of bank and PSP sites that can hold captures Wayback missed. Critical caveat: most of the collection is closed for copyright/privacy reasons and served only through a restricted research interface.
candidates.access_status: partly open (seed-list and sub-collection search); bulk content behind closed research access

candidates.why_relevant: The successor entity has partially re-hosted the pre-merger MKB Bank Nyrt. financial reports and maintains a Takarekbank archive section - i.e. a live mirror of part of the wiped IR estate. Because re-hosted archives are themselves volatile, it should be harvested now and cross-checked against Wayback.

candidates.why_relevant: Exchange-side mirror of issuer disclosures for OTP and other listed financials, with per-issuer company cards offering the latest annual report and downloadable data. A second copy of the MNB OAM filings, organised by ticker and usable when the OAM search is awkward; BET pages also carry HU/EN parallel content.
candidates.access_status: open web; some content behind heavy JS/session paths
candidates.legal_status: exchange terms of use; issuer copyright on filings

candidates.source_name: European e-Justice Portal / BRIS - Find a company
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level federated search across national business registers including Hungary's, exposing EUID-keyed records, branch and cross-border merger information in English. It is the canonical cross-border entry point that translates Hungarian register data for non-Hungarian users and documents exactly which HU company forms are in scope.

candidates.legal_status: EU public sector information; national fee rules apply to documents

candidates.source_name: European Single Access Point (ESAP) - ESMA
candidates.why_relevant: Forthcoming EU-wide, free, machine-readable aggregation of financial and sustainability disclosures, fed from national OAMs including MNB Kozzetetelek. Collection is expected to start July 2026 with publication no later than 10 July 2027 - meaning the cheapest future route to Hungarian bank filings in normalised English form. Must be tracked now so the collection architecture can switch to it.
candidates.access_status: not yet live; regulation and technical standards published
candidates.legal_status: EU regulation mandates free access and machine readability
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor ESMA ESAP pages and implementing technical standards; plan an API-based ingest for 2027 to replace per-portal crawling.

candidates.source_name: ECB Banking Supervision - List of Supervised Entities (and RIAD master data)
candidates.why_relevant: Periodic PDF/spreadsheet lists of significant and less-significant institutions, archived monthly back years. Hungary is a non-euro, non-SSM member state so HU banks appear mainly as subsidiaries/branches of SSM groups (Erste, Raiffeisen, UniCredit, KBC/K&H) - which is exactly how a large share of the Hungarian banking market is disclosed at group level in English. RIAD underlies the entity identifiers, with MNB as the national hub.
candidates.access_status: open PDF/data downloads; RIAD itself not publicly queryable
candidates.legal_status: public sector information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download successive dated list PDFs/spreadsheets and extract entries whose country of establishment is HU; diff over time to track group-structure changes.

The classic academic/industry route to long HU bank time series without re-parsing Hungarian PDFs.

negative_findings.description: No public, machine-readable EU-level or third-party mirror was found that specifically archives Hungarian bank INVESTOR-RELATIONS pages as such (as opposed to filings). Archival coverage of retired HU bank IR estates rests on general-purpose web archives (Wayback, OSZK) rather than any finance-specific mirror.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in HU and EN for archived HU bank IR pages surfaced only general web archives plus the successor bank's own re-hosted sections.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical IR narrative material (presentations, press-release indexes) has no authoritative custodian, so it must be actively harvested and self-archived before it decays.

negative_findings.description: The OSZK Webarchivum's substantive holdings - including the six-monthly national web-space snapshots since 2017 - are not publicly served; only a small share is open, with the rest behind a closed research interface.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public documentation states most of the collection is restricted for copyright and privacy reasons; contact route is webarchivum@oszk.hu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most likely alternative archive to Wayback for HU bank sites cannot be used programmatically without a negotiated research access arrangement.

negative_findings.description: Hungary is outside the euro area and the SSM, so the ECB's supervised-entity lists and RIAD do not cover HU-headquartered banks directly; only HU subsidiaries/branches of SSM groups appear. Likewise the EBA transparency exercise sample includes only a small number of HU-linked banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: No HU-specific bank list was confirmed inside ECB SSM publications; EBA transparency sample membership per year was not enumerated in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts may over-assume EU-level registers give complete HU banking coverage; national MNB/e-beszamolo sources remain indispensable for the domestic-only institutions.

negative_findings.description: The three strongest cross-border normalisation layers for Hungarian bank financials - Orbis Bank Focus, EMIS and D&B/Bisnode - are all subscription products, and none publishes a verifiable Hungary coverage list publicly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Product and library pages describe scope generically; no free HU bank coverage manifest found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and licensing decisions must be made partly blind; a trial-based coverage test on named HU banks and PSPs is needed before committing.

negative_findings.description: ESAP, the intended EU-wide aggregation of national OAM filings (including MNB Kozzetetelek), is not live; collection is expected to begin July 2026 with publication by 10 July 2027 and phased content additions to 2031.
negative_findings.result_summary: Regulation and timelines confirmed; no queryable endpoint exists today.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any architecture built now on per-portal crawling should be designed so ESAP can replace several crawlers in 2027 without a rebuild.

negative_findings.description: No established Hungarian-language term was found for 'web archive of investor relations pages' as a service category; Hungarian searching had to fall back on generic 'webarchivum' / 'archiv' plus bank names, which is noisy because 'archiv' on HU bank sites usually labels retired product pages and online-banking notices, not IR history.
negative_findings.result_summary: HU queries combining 'befektetoi kapcsolatok' + 'archivum' returned product archives (e.g. investment-fund archives, netbank archives) rather than IR document archives.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for HU archival discovery must anchor on document nouns (eves jelentes, penzugyi kimutatas, kozzetetel) rather than on 'archivum'.

coverage_gaps.description: The legacy-entity list whose IR estates need archival recovery is not yet enumerated beyond MKB, Budapest Bank and Takarekbank - other wound-down or absorbed HU institutions (savings-cooperative brands under the Takarek umbrella, Sberbank Magyarorszag, Commerzbank Zrt., MagNet/Granit predecessor brands) are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a legacy-entity register from the EBA credit institutions register withdrawal records plus the HU company register successor entries, then run Wayback CDX enumeration per retired domain.

coverage_gaps.description: No verification was done of how deep Wayback's captures actually go for mkb.hu, takarekbank.hu and budapestbank.hu IR sub-paths, nor whether the PDFs themselves (not just the index pages) were captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a CDX enumeration pass per legacy host restricted to .pdf and IR path prefixes, and record capture counts and date ranges as a measured coverage baseline.

coverage_gaps.description: PSP/fintech-specific aggregators and archives were only partially covered - the EBA PSD2 register is captured, but national-register mirrors used by payments-industry vendors, and archives of retired Hungarian PSP sites, were not explored.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend discovery to payments-sector directories and to the MNB national PSP register as the upstream of the EBA mirror, then archive-check retired HU PSP domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Closed-collection access to the OSZK Webarchivum and commercial licence terms for Opten/D&B/EMIS/Orbis are unresolved, so the realistic collection method for a large part of this cell is currently unpriced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open a research-access enquiry with OSZK and request coverage tests plus pricing from Opten and one global aggregator, benchmarked on a fixed list of ten HU banks and PSPs.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language normalisation of HU bank filings is available almost exclusively through paid aggregators; among free sources only the EBA datasets, ECB lists and BET/issuer English pages provide it, and statutory filings on e-beszamolo and the MNB OAM are Hungarian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan a machine-translation and terminology-mapping layer over Hungarian statutory filings rather than assuming an English source exists.

brief: For Hungarian bank and PSP disclosures, the durable cross-border layer has three tiers: EU-level regulator datasets and registers (EBA transparency exercise CSVs, EBA credit-institution and PSD2 registers, ECB supervised-entity lists, BRIS, and ESAP from 2027) which are free, English and machine-readable but cover only the EU-facing slice of the Hungarian market; national statutory archives (MNB Kozzetetelek as the official appointed mechanism, e-beszamolo for statutory accounts, BET for issuer news) which are complete but Hungarian-only and form-driven; and commercial aggregators (Opten Merlegtar, Dun & Bradstreet Hungary ex-Bisnode, Ceginfo, Ceginformacio, EMIS, Orbis Bank Focus) which normalise and translate but are paywalled with unverified Hungary coverage. Because the MKB/Budapest Bank/Takarekbank consolidation into MBH erased whole IR estates, web archives are load-bearing rather than supplementary: the Wayback Machine is the practical archive of retired Hungarian bank IR pages, while the national OSZK Webarchivum holds richer six-monthly snapshots but serves most of them only through a closed research interface. The main risks in this cell are that archival depth for the retired domains is unmeasured, that EU-level registers are widely over-assumed to cover non-euro Hungary fully, and that MBH's own re-hosted legacy archives are themselves volatile and should be harvested and self-archived now.
